get.description: Retrieves a booking quote from Launch27.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: quote_uuid
parameters.description: Launch27 quote UUID used to retrieve a booking quote.

schema.description: Launch27 quote UUID used to retrieve a booking quote.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

address.description: Customer address from the booking quote.

arrival_window.description: Arrival window selected for the quoted booking.

city.description: Customer city from the booking quote.

custom_fields.description: Quoted custom field values to reuse when turning the quote into a booking.

customer_notes.description: Customer notes captured on the quote.

discount_code.description: Discount code carried by the quote.

email.description: Customer email from the booking quote.

final_price.description: Final quoted booking price used to populate the booking summary.

first_name.description: Customer first name from the booking quote.

frequency_id.description: Launch27 frequency ID referenced by the booking quote.

last_name.description: Customer last name from the booking quote.

location_id.description: Launch27 location ID referenced by the booking quote.

payment_method.description: Payment method code stored on the quote.

phone.description: Customer phone number from the booking quote.

service_date.description: Quoted service date/time used to prefill booking scheduling.

services.description: Quoted service selections, including pricing parameters and extras.

sms_notifications.description: Whether SMS notifications are enabled on the quote.

state.description: Customer state from the booking quote.

tip.description: One-time tip amount stored on the quote.

tip_recurring.description: Recurring tip amount stored on the quote.

zip.description: Customer postal code from the booking quote.
